name: Social Seeding campaign orchestrator — grounded sourcing golden set
description: 4 real cases exercising the source->vet->outreach->verify loop with mandatory web grounding. Cases require the orchestrator to ground 2026 K-beauty / TikTok market claims via research_brand + google_search and to source ranked creators via search_creators (live ss-mcp A2A plan_creator_search, RapidAPI fallback). Judged by the gemini-3.5-flash rubric LLM-judge in ../eval_config.json.

parts.text: I'm launching a Korean vegan Vitamin C serum on TikTok. Find Korean vegan skincare TikTok creators to seed, and ground the 2026 K-beauty Vitamin C trend with sources before you recommend anyone.
Research the 2026 K-beauty TikTok trends I should know about before planning a seeding campaign. Cite your sources.
Numbuzin is our main competitor in K-beauty serums. Research their recent TikTok positioning with sources, then find creators we could seed who do NOT already post about Numbuzin.
Source 10 TikTok creators for a sample-only seeding deal on a post-laser recovery cream, and tell me the next step in the source->vet->outreach->verify loop after sourcing.
